prose.subject: Vendor Account Update & Invoice INV-80547
prose.body:
Dear Ines,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you of a recent administrative update regarding our payout details at Corvane Labs. We have recently added a new payout account, 0x5f8d4a3980a1ef4b5008d787a9d84a2fac250f69, and linked it to our domain for streamlined processing.

Please ensure that this address is noted in your vendor records for future payments. For the current billing cycle, I have attached invoice INV-80547 for your review. The total amount due is 9417.67 USDC.

Could you please confirm receipt of this email and the attached invoice? If the new account details are not yet reflected in your system, kindly update your records at your earliest convenience to avoid any delays in processing. 

Should you have any questions regarding the invoice or the account change, please do not hesitate to reach out. We appreciate your continued partnership and prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Omar Kowal
Accounts Payable Specialist
Rowan Payroll
